name: Image File Size Estimator
description: Estimate uncompressed image memory size from dimensions, channels and bit depth.
search_intent: Estimate raw image size before compression.
calculation: Total bits = width × height × channels × bits per channel. Bytes = bits / 8. KiB = bytes / 1024. MiB = bytes / 1,048,576.
limitations: This estimates uncompressed pixel data rather than JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF size.
Actual files also contain headers, metadata and compression overhead.
